$comment: Model catalogue for the Public.com chat tab.
Every entry was verified against the Workers AI catalogue for this account,
including the function_calling property: without that a model cannot call
Public.com's tools at all, which is the whole point of the tab. Prices are the
published per-million-token rates at the time of writing and are for guidance
only - check the dashboard before relying on them.
1. The user's choice in the dashboard, which persists in the agent's state.
A model id that is not listed here is still selectable via the picker only if
it appears in models; unknown ids fall back to defaultModel.

models.label: GPT-OSS 120B
models.description: Best tool use of the set. Reasoning model, and the default.

models.label: GPT-OSS 20B
models.description: Cheaper sibling of the 120B; fine for single-step lookups.

models.label: Nemotron 3 120B
models.description: Large context (256k) and strong reasoning; more expensive.

models.label: GLM 4.7 Flash
models.description: Cheapest of the large-context options; good value for reads.

models.label: Qwen3 30B A3B
models.description: Very cheap input, but only a 32k context window.

models.label: Mistral Small 3.1 24B
models.description: Mid-range alternative with tool calling and vision.

models.label: Llama 3.3 70B (previous default)
models.description: Kept for comparison. Only a 24k context, and weaker multi-step tool use - it tended to answer from a single portfolio read instead of quoting and comparing.
